title: DOJ: trial under Military Order Number One

tellings.quote: the DOJ said that I'd be tried under military order number one, which is Guantanamo status.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British hacker who says he broke into NASA and US military computers and found signs of a secret space programme, says the US Department of Justice told him he would be tried under Military Order Number One, "which is Guantanamo status". McKinnon tells Michels this from his own case in the 2000s, as a measure of how seriously the US government took what he had seen.
